notes: In Brazil, 'camiseta' almost always refers to a standard cotton t-shirt with short sleeves.
Do not confuse this with 'camisa', which typically refers to a button-up shirt with a collar.

senses.definition: A simple garment for the upper body, usually made of cotton with short sleeves and no collar.
